# SmartDentist

> SmartDentist is dental clinic management software for dental clinics in India, currently focused on Patna, Bihar. It automatically sends WhatsApp recall reminders to patients based on the treatment they received, so patients come back for follow-ups without clinic staff manually tracking dates or calling anyone.

## Who it is for

- Dentists and dental clinics in India (currently focused on Patna).
- Single clinics and clinics with more than one branch.

## Recall reminders

- Each treatment type has a recall interval in days, set by the clinic. New clinics start with suggested intervals (for example 180 days after scaling, 7 days after an extraction), which the clinic can change.
- When a visit is recorded, the recall date is set from that treatment type's interval.
- Up to three WhatsApp reminders per recall: the day before the due date, 2 hours before the appointment time (only when a time is set), and a follow-up the day after.
- Patient replies on WhatsApp are shown to clinic staff under "Replies Waiting" on the Today page, for staff to act on. Replies do not book appointments automatically.
- Staff can pause, resume or decline a recall.
- Do Not Disturb can be turned on per patient; SmartDentist then sends that patient no WhatsApp messages.
- Reminders are sent in English using a Meta-approved WhatsApp message template.

## Other features

- Patient records: visit and treatment history, and medical history (e.g. diabetes, hypertension, allergies) entered once and carried onto prescriptions. Allergies are flagged on the patient's page.
- FDI-numbered tooth chart for selecting the teeth treated, with separate adult and child (milk teeth) charts.
- Appointments and walk-ins: book ahead or add walk-ins, record vitals and chief complaint at check-in, track waiting / in chair / done, and mark no-shows.
- Prescriptions: printed on the clinic's own letterhead (logo, address, timings) or sent to the patient as a PDF on WhatsApp.
- Clinic medicine list with default dosage and duration that fill in automatically when prescribing.
- Billing: fee and optional discount per visit, payments by cash, UPI, card or bank transfer, and each patient's total paid and balance due.
- Multi-branch: one account for several branches. The clinic owner sees every branch; each receptionist sees only their own branch's patients.
- Recall report (owner only): reminders sent, delivered and replied to, patients who came back, and amount collected from those return visits.

## Details

- Runs in the web browser (web application); no installation needed.
- Based in Patna, India.
- Website: https://smartdentist.pages.dev/
- Contact: alokkumar.in91@gmail.com
- Demo: clinics can request a demo using the form at https://smartdentist.pages.dev/#demo
- The clinic application itself (/app) requires a login and is not public content.
